tools.name: deel_get_demo
tools.description: Returns the URL to book a live demo with the Deel sales team. Use this when a user expresses interest in trying Deel, wants to see a product walkthrough, or asks how to get started.

tools.name: deel_get_hiring_guide
tools.description: Returns a link to the Deel country hiring guide for a given country. The guide covers local employment law, hiring costs, notice periods, tax obligations, and compliance requirements. Use this when a user asks how to hire in a specific country or wants to understand local labour laws.

country.description: The country to look up, as a lowercase slug (e.g. "germany", "united-states", "brazil"). Use hyphens for multi-word country names.

tools.name: deel_get_products
tools.description: Returns the full catalogue of Deel products grouped by category (Hiring & Payroll, HR, IT, Platform). Each product includes a name, description, and a link to its marketing page on deel.com. Use this when a user asks what Deel offers, which products are available, or wants to compare product areas.
